approach: Resolve the acceleration into components along and perpendicular to the initial velocity, then combine using v = u + at and s = ut + ½at².

steps.text: Take the initial velocity along the x-axis and resolve the acceleration into components at 60° to it.
Find the velocity components at t = 2 s using v = u + at.
Combine the components to get the speed.
Find the displacement components at t = 2 s using s = ut + ½at².
Combine the components to get the magnitude of the displacement.

common_mistakes.text: Treating the motion as one-dimensional and using v = u + at with plain numbers gives 6 m/s instead of about 5.29 m/s.
Treating the motion as one-dimensional and using s = ut + ½at² with plain numbers gives 8 m instead of about 6.93 m.
